Cost: 500eb (Expensive) for 1
Stack: 1

Thrown only; not for Grenade Launchers. Hovers over its landing square and for 9 seconds (3 Rounds) sweeps a 6x6m/yds (3x3 square) area with lasers. Anyone starting their Turn there or passing through must beat DV17 Evasion or Contortionist or take 4d6, which doesn't ablate armor or harm Cover and ignores armor below SP 12. Its Critical Injuries roll twice and the thrower picks. Afterward it drops, Destroyed Beyond Repair.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Ammunition).
